sentences.en: I was surprised at her inability to do things promptly.
sentences.zh: 我惊讶于她做事不够及时。

sentences.en: I am impatient with his inability to make decisions.
sentences.zh: 我对他的决策能力差感到不耐烦。

sentences.en: Inability to disprove a theory does not mean it is right.
sentences.zh: 无法反驳一个理论并不意味着它是正确的。

senses.zh: 无能，无力,无才能,无能为力
